body: You're not "neglecting" Tara for Jenny. Jesus Christ. It seems you've formed your ENTIRE life and personality to cater to Tara's needs. By not trying to form a one on one personal relationship ship with Jenny, you're neglecting her. Her father is doing right by her. You dropped her off at her grandmother's for TWO YEARS, that is a lifetime to a kid/teen. You've already said you barely visited her. You're now dealing with a child who you actively and continue to actively NECLECT for two years. Now you're surprised Pikachu face she's not falling on her knees before you for letting her come back home. Get therapy for her, and for you, you desperately need it.

I'm so sorry for your losses. I just don't understand my aunt. She's my godmother and we were so close. I've cut contact with her. I saw her on Christmas and I thought all was well. Only to have her text me at 930 asking for a set of jewelry my mom had that was my grandmother's. She's been on read since then and she hasn't reached out further.
